name: akoya_request-test-request-reminder-controls
_comment: Sandbox parity subset of the existing wave7 reviewer-engagement contract. Add only the two reminder-disable controls required for a synthetic Request create. Creation-only and idempotent; do not copy the rest of wave7 or change an existing attribute.

attributes.description: Campaign config: whether the respond-by reminder fires for this request (Phase 3). Default Enabled. Synthetic requests explicitly write false at create.
Campaign config: whether the review-due reminder fires for this request (Phase 3). Default Enabled. Synthetic requests explicitly write false at create.
